newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BZW unit launches A$500 million, 4.5 year FRN.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BZW unit launches A$500 million, 4.5 year FRN.

text.p: BZW Australia Ltd unit Australian Mortgage Securities (AMS) has launched a A$500 million mortgage-backed floating rate note issue.

The senior tranche of A$485 million worth of floating rate notes with an average life of 4.5 years was the largest single senior tranche of mortgage-backed securities yet made in Australia, BZW said in a statement.
The second tranche was A$15 million of 9.5-year subordinated floating rate notes.
BZW did not give any pricing details.
The securities had no step-up coupon and no attached options, a BZW spokesperson told Reuters.
The senior notes were expected to be rated AAA by Standard & Poor's and Aaa by Moody's Investors Service while the subordinated tranche was seen rated AA-minus/A1, BZW said.
BZW said it was lead manager and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell lead arranger of the issue.
Allocations to investors would occur on November 28, BZW said.
AMS managing director, Kym Dalton, said: " We will increase the frequency of issues while maintaining our traditional focus on quality service to our originator clients."
AMS, a leading mortgage management company, was sold by the Australian Mutual Provident Society to BZW last week for an undisclosed sum.
